_note: B12 ratchet: total non-test Go LOC ceiling. Raising this is a conscious act reviewed in the PR that needs it. Measured 19470 at 2026-08-11 (v0.22.0: +72 for two catalog-composition fixes, both measured on the live machine. (a) The skills walk required a `name:` frontmatter field and silently dropped anything without one -- while overwriting s.Name with the DIRECTORY name three lines later, so the requirement changed nothing except excluding valid skills; it dropped all 11 searchfit-seo skills, every one invocable. (b) A marketplace cache dir holds the WHOLE marketplace's skills while the installed plugin owns a subset, so harvesting it under one pack minted 13 uninvocable `document-skills:*` IDs which then won description-dedup and suppressed the real frontend-design:frontend-design and skill-creator:skill-creator. ownedSkillDirs reads the authoritative .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and filters ONLY when it names the pack, so every root without ownership data is untouched). Prior: 19398 at 2026-08-11 (v0.21.0: +287, of which ~150 are the adversarial-review round -- two reviewers independently reproduced that the FIRST draft (a) could not degrade at all for a SLOW reranker, because the fallback re-embedded and embed+rerank+embed cannot fit one deadline, so the likely failure mode produced 'deadline exceeded' and surfaced nothing; (b) recorded the degradation on only 1 of 5 outcome modes, leaving ~half of rows (gated-empty especially) byte-identical to healthy ones; (c) posted raw prompt text to an unprobed port, defeating the embed path's deliberate probe-before-send guard, and pinned the reranker to eps[0] while the embedder failed over; and (d) silently coerced a misspelled -ranker to embed. The fix restructures to embed-once-then-Reorder (degraded path is now free), adds a live-endpoint probe, a minimum-deadline guard, flag validation, and carries degradeErr out of the goroutine so every outcome records it. +137 was the original wiring to wire embed+rerank into PRODUCTION surfacing -- EmbedRerank.RetrieveScored (reranked ORDER, embed cosines preserved in .Score, primary topCos passed through so the -min-cosine gate admits exactly the same prompts as embed-only), the shared rerankOrder extracted so Retrieve and RetrieveScored can never disagree, and rerankOrEmbed in mr-hook. That last piece is the non-obvious cost: EmbedRerank propagates every failure BY DESIGN because a silent fallback would score embed-only under the embed+rerank label in the eval -- but in production that same strictness turns a reranker hiccup into decide() reporting embedder-down and surfacing NOTHING. rerankOrEmbed degrades to embed ORDER and rewrites the logged mode to "embed" so the row never claims a rerank that did not run). Prior: 19111 at 2026-08-11 (v0.20.0: +247 for the refresh root-decay fix. Roughly 100 of that is the fix itself -- roots.Stale, reuseRoots, and threading notes into refreshStatus.StaleRoots -- and the remaining ~145 is adversarial review, which reproduced two ways the FIRST draft made things strictly worse than the bug it fixed. (a) isDir collapsed 'provably absent' and 'Stat failed', so a deny ACE or an unreachable UNC path looked exactly like an uninstall, forced rediscovery, and Save then deleted the root PERMANENTLY -- reproduced: a live 3-skill pack dropped and did not return after the ACE was removed. Stale now has a third class, unknown, which is reported with the real error and never triggers rediscovery. (b) rediscovery was asserted, never verified: when a plugin was mid-extraction the replacement did not exist, the pack was dropped, and its root was erased from roots.json so refresh had nothing left to trip on -- reproduced as three consecutive silent ok:true runs, the last with the plugin fully healthy. roots.json is now left UNCHANGED when a dead pack did not come back, which is self-healing. Both classes cost lines because both are silent-permanent-loss bugs, which is the entire category this release exists to close). Prior: 18864 at 2026-07-30 (v0.19.0: +180 for the R9.3 rerank eval leg -- EmbedRerank + the /v1/rerank client + the mr-eval row; eval-only code, the verdict it produced was NEGATIVE and nothing wires into production). Prior: 18684 (v0.18.0: +65 for R9.2b candidate logging -- Cand type + MarshalJSON rounding + the deeper-retrieve/surface-prefix split in decide). Prior: 18619 (v0.17.0: +79 flat-root harvest, then +126 review-round fixes -- build merge-preserve + fatal-invalid roots.json, ValidKind, kind-aware hook rendering, ordered flat dedup contract). Prior: 18414 at 2026-07-27 (v0.16.0: requireModelPins + pinFlagsFor, then the review-round fixes -- normalizePins, parseLanes, and the model-in-rowKey change; +114 non-test lines total. The last increment is buildRunPlan, extracted from main() in review round 2 because the three defects lived at the CALL SITES and pure-function unit tests could not constrain them -- mutation-verified: reverting the resume key, the pin normalization or the lane dedupe now fails a test, where previously all three left the whole repo suite green). The v0.15.0 note recorded 18286 against a 18300 ceiling and warned that 14 lines of headroom meant the next change of any size would have to raise it deliberately — this is that change, and the canary caught it rather than a reviewer, which is the ratchet working as intended. Keep this number in sync with the measurement: round 2's note said 17973 while the tree held 18003 and round 3's said 18168 while it held 18286-ish; both were caught by review, which is exactly the drift an earlier audit flagged.
